posts.name: Rahul
posts.cooked: After executing synchro eval, there is an additional file by the name of script.sh in the CWD. The script.sh passes the test_case arguments to the convert_file.sh. The last line of script.sh is “ rm temp_out.txt”. So it is understood that the temp_out.txt will created and deleted after the script.sh has been executed. But synchro eval searches of file temp_out.txt which seems to be already removed by script.sh. My script “convert_file.sh” is working fine with locally created csv file but I am not able to understand the issue.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
You can refer the solutions here.

There are no issues with eval script.
